authorized_current_source.instrument: Estimated sterling instantaneous OIS forward curve based on SONIA
authorized_current_source.method: Exact official 3M/6M/12M forward-curve columns; no interpolation

blocker.summary: The current BoE OIS archive covers the required dates, but the Bank states that archive yield-curve data are subject to revisions and exposes the latest archive rather than a verified point-in-time vintage set.

official_source_statement.archive_updates: Updates to archive yield-curve data are made available by close of business of the second working day of each month.
official_source_statement.revision_policy: Data are subject to revisions; the latest data are available on the Bank of England website.

blocker.pit_implication: A file downloaded in 2026 cannot, by itself, prove the exact values that were available to a historical decision in 2018-2025. Without official or directly licensed historical vintages, look-ahead through revisions cannot be excluded.

decision.next_safe_option: Revisit only if official or directly licensed vintage archive snapshots can establish the values available at each historical decision timestamp.
